info.name: Atlassian Get Audit Records for Time Period

params.name: number
params.description: The number of units for the time period.

params.name: units
params.description: The unit of time that the time period is measured in.

params.name: searchString
params.description:
Filters the results to records that have string property values
matching the `searchString`.

params.name: start
params.description: The starting index of the returned records.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of records to return per page.
Note, this may be restricted by fixed system limits.

items.docs: The Atlassian Confluence Audit API endpoint `/wiki/rest/api/audit/since` using the GET method retrieves audit records that have been created since a specified time period. This operation allows administrators and authorized users to query and review system audit logs within a defined timeframe, providing visibility into user actions, system changes, and security-related events that occurred after a particular timestamp.
